name: Arkansas
overview: The homestead credit reduces qualifying homeowners' property-tax liability without an income test.

programs.name: Homestead Property Tax Credit
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces the qualifying homestead's assessed real-property tax by up to the annual credit.
programs.application: Register the homestead and establish eligibility with the county assessor.
eligibilityNotes: Applies to a qualifying owner-occupied homestead.
Assessment year and bill-payment year differ.
interactions: Assessment limitations and disability/veteran exemptions are separate forms of relief.

researchNotes: DFA confirms Act 330 of 2025 increased the credit; the fiscal statement specifies 2025 assessment-year applicability.
Do not substitute a 2025 cash-payment comparison for the 2025 assessment-year credit.
